text: My office has been receiving concerns from residents on the south side of Sammon Avenue (Coxwell Avenue to Woodington Avenue) about hospital visitors blocking access to their driveways. I would like to recommend changing the “No Parking” to “No Stopping” to deter vehicles from stopping on the south side of Sammon Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Sammon Avenue, between Woodmount Avenue and Pape Avenue. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Sammon Avenue, between Dewhurst Boulevard North and a point 32.5 metres west of Coxwell Avenue. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Sammon Avenue, between Coxwell Avenue and Woodington Avenue. 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Sammon Avenue, between Woodington Avenue and Woodmount Avenue.
